explication: Goose is a general-purpose, locally run AI agent delivered as a desktop app, CLI, and embeddable API. A typical interaction enters through the desktop chat or an API/CLI session, loads or creates session state, prepares a prompt, obtains provider inference, and may invoke MCP extensions before returning a response. The repository also has distinct provider/configuration, extension, session persistence, and gateway capabilities. Edges are limited to README statements and relationships visible in the supplied excerpts or SOURCE INDEX; some UI-to-server wiring is therefore left unverified.
